# 1813. Sentence Similarity III

## Solution 1 (time O(m+n), space O(m+n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def areSentencesSimilar(self, sentence1, sentence2):
        """
        :type sentence1: str
        :type sentence2: str
        :rtype: bool
        """
        s1 = sentence1.split()
        s2 = sentence2.split()
        if len(s1) >= len(s2):
            s1, s2 = s2, s1
        n1, n2 = len(s1), len(s2)
        p1 = 0
        while p1 < n1 and s1[p1] == s2[p1]:
            p1 += 1
        p2 = 0
        while n1 - 1 - p2 >= p1 and s1[n1 - 1 - p2] == s2[n2 - 1 - p2]:
            p2 += 1
        return p1 + p2 == n1
```
